edits.new:
`RouteDecisionWorkflow` is the one workflow the ownership rows give S1; the three activities are this branch's and the remaining activities of the route decision belong to the sibling stories. The activity names are a target design choice, fixed by the baseline so that the workflow history is stable.

Start rule: `RouteDecisionWorkflow` is started by `CaseWorkflow` as a child when the case reaches route decision D6 or is reopened (`ROUTE_D6_REOPEN`). The workflow ID form and the duplicate-start policy are Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-8154).

Screen states of SCR-13: no access, refused with MSG-P4-002 (403 before any read); error, when the decision-record write fails, nothing applied and MSG-P7-003 shown; empty and loading, Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S1-E4009-APP-10).

Personal data: the fields this story carries are classed by Data Classification v5; which of them are personal data is Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S1-E4009-APP-11).
